objective: Define fail-closed server-side materialization watermarks for ANA behavioral facts and ORD metric facts so A07/A09 can derive dataThrough without max(event timestamp), computedAt, or assumed windowEnd authority.

rootCause.behaviorGap: private.analytics_behavior_events_v1 has server-owned received_at/occurred_at facts but no server-authoritative watermark proving the ledger is materialized through an empty or non-empty time boundary.
rootCause.orderGap: private.order_metric_events is an atomic ORD projection but no watermark proves which committed projection facts are materialized through a boundary; occurred_at is event time and cannot itself prove materialization completeness.
rootCause.concurrencyRisk: A transaction can be in flight while a projection reads. A max event timestamp or clock-only watermark could overclaim completeness if that transaction commits later with a materialization timestamp at or before the claimed boundary.

watermarkBasis.activeTransactionScope: all backends in current_database() with xact_start not null, excluding pg_backend_pid()
watermarkBasis.rationale: Any transaction already in flight has a transaction start strictly after the predecessor boundary; any transaction starting later is also after it. Therefore a later commit cannot introduce a source row whose server-owned materialization timestamp is <= the published watermark. Prepared transactions are separately fail-closed.

dependencies.materializationTimeAuthority: database default now() on private ORD metric projection inserted atomically by private.project_order_domain_event

projectionRules.lateFactPolicy: A source fact whose event time belongs to an older metric period but whose materialization time is after a prior dataThrough is excluded from that prior read and must enter through A05 append-only revision/backfill semantics when recomputed; prior finalized snapshots are never silently overwritten.
projectionRules.emptyWindowRule: A watermark may advance with zero source rows because completeness is proven by the transaction floor rather than by event presence.

activationRequirements: create a new forward-only migration; do not edit historical A03/ORD migrations
implement prepared-transaction fail-closed behavior and current-database active-transaction floor
return source-specific behavior and ORD watermark envelopes using received_at and created_at materialization semantics
ensure anon/authenticated cannot execute private watermark functions
make A09 runtime filter source rows by materialization time as well as canonical event time
preserve A05 append-only revision semantics for late materialized facts
validate no-active-transaction, in-flight-transaction, empty-window, prepared-transaction fail-closed and late-fact scenarios in staging
require explicit staging authorization before applying the migration or executing mutating canaries

maturity.reason: This lot closes the repository authority for behavior/ORD dependency watermarks only. Runtime functions, migration application, A09 projector/freshness thresholds and controlled staging evidence remain required before maturity can change.
